acceptance: Build/native/runtime results are separate hash-bound reports; this contract alone is not acceptance.

legacy.new_key_absent: Retain the original branch, formula, defaults and old flags.

audio.meaning: Shard intensity; zero uses the recovered 8-bit mantissa default.

sensors.meaning: Accelerometer family constant axis bias in m/s^2; explicit zero gives no bias.

seed_rules.environment: Existing nonzero uint64 decimal environment seed is never rewritten.
seed_rules.shardx_explicit: 1..UINT32_MAX; larger explicit mode seed is rejected.
seed_rules.shardx_inherited: Version 1 uses the existing UxrPixelNoiseSeed fold; uint32 inputs unchanged, folded zero becomes one.
seed_rules.companions_without_mode: New mode-seed/amount keys require an explicit corresponding mode.

identity.native_scope: UA/UA-CH/navigator.platform; preserves other shared platform consumers.

memory.scope: One getter for navigator and Client Hints; does not alter allocation or V8 heap.

screen.native_scope: Screen/work-area/orientation/DPR fields; viewport and native window settings remain separate.

hardware_profile.precedence: Explicit caller CPU/RAM/WebGL values and per-field native modes win.
hardware_profile.memory: An explicit empty/native memory field stays native; generated numeric memory uses coherent custom mode.
hardware_profile.gpu_identity: Uses the independent GPU mode; does not turn on legacy compatibility/synthetic pixel or text policies.
hardware_profile.scope: Recorded metadata and deterministic CPU/RAM choices; no physical hardware emulation.

legacy.behavior: Preserved original local policy, seeds and helper formulas; external Canvas Bridge and synthetic-only backend fixtures are retired in the Lite build

canvas.storage: Owned completed RGBA8/BGRA8 output; original drawing pixels are not mutated
canvas.other_formats: Native fallback; float16/HDR algorithms are not implemented
canvas.chromix: Existing uint64 seed fold and absolute-coordinate RGB +/-1 algorithm
canvas.shardx: Production compatible-v1: independent-seed absolute-coordinate sparse RGB low-bit candidates and canonical 2x2 flat-cell preservation, shared by cropped readback and export; alpha guard retained. Reference/helper flavor retains the historical xoshiro128** 32-assignment model.

cloak.core: Byte-verified hash and ten sparse LSB candidates
intentional_differences: Logical RGB bit ordering on both RGBA and BGRA, correcting the original export R/B discrepancy
Choose on the complete canvas and project into cropped readback
Preserve every partial-alpha pixel rather than infer an unverified original arithmetic branch

reference_bank.reason: Observed original reference matching can replace different real colors with identical stored images/pixels
reference_bank.original_mechanism_research: Separate 68-record bank, unique matcher, and false/raw distinctions documented in the research

native_fallback_conditions: Unavailable snapshot or unsuccessful actual read
ShardX neighborhood allocation or completed snapshot read unavailable; no fail-closed privacy claim

webgl.production_seed_sequence: Absolute-coordinate keyed ShardX V2 mask; no process or read counter
webgl.supported_readback: Service-completed RGBA8 and RGBA32F readback from default/user framebuffers, TypedArray and PBO paths, including clipped extents and transparent contexts; actual-driver acceptance is separate
webgl.completion_proof: Native GLES2 completion status and clipped extents; no alpha sentinel inference
fallbacks: Unsupported format/type combinations, including HALF_FLOAT, packed and integer formats
Completion support or valid completed region unavailable
Staging or neighborhood allocation/read failure; native pixels retained
Full HDR algorithm equivalence is not established
webgl.errors: Never consume the page GL error queue; failed/incomplete staging does not alter the caller buffer
webgl.shardx_export: Owned RGBA8/BGRA8 export uses the same coordinate mask and canonical flat-cell decision, with bottom/top orientation and premultiplied-alpha handling
webgl.cloak_export: Logical RGB and top-left full-canvas coordinates agree with the corresponding supported GL readback
webgl.flat_region_guard: Canonical coordinate-anchored 2x2 cells with a same-surface 1px halo at crop boundaries; only assigned RGB low bits are ignored
webgl.context_loss: Retain DrawingBuffer and GLES transport through PACK restoration; exit after synchronous loss, never write back a PBO after loss

export_routing.source: Actual canvas rendering context, classified as Canvas2D/WebGL/Other at the HTML or Offscreen call site
export_routing.transport: Immutable value object through ImageDataBuffer and both CanvasAsyncBlobCreator constructors
export_routing.async_processing: Once-prepared image buffer retained across idle, worker and encoder-thread paths
export_routing.unknown_source: Retain legacy behavior; never guess Canvas2D
export_routing.bridge: External Canvas Bridge, its network client, drawing-record hooks, remote pixel/text substitutions and unsafe sandbox switch are removed

seeds.cloak: Nonzero uint64 serialized as canonical decimal ASCII
seeds.shardx: Effective uint32; explicit values outside 1..UINT32_MAX rejected by the common parser; environment-seed folding is a separately documented launcher v1 rule

gpu.custom_identity: Complete vendor/renderer or vendor/architecture pairs required; unsupported combinations are rejected.
gpu.webgl_custom_semantics: Clamp real validation caches downward; 3D/array fields apply only to WebGL2. Other numeric enum overrides rejected in this mode.
gpu.webgpu_features_semantics: Subset of real adapter support. Empty custom list has no optional features; real core feature remains.
gpu.webgpu_limits_semantics: Conservative public ceiling, validate requests then forward unchanged to Dawn; no fake device-limit restoration.
gpu.device_info: Retain actual subgroup range and developer visibility; no synthetic device/driver identity.

media_counts.policy: Upper bounds on actually enumerated devices, preserving native IDs, permission labels and selected capabilities.
media_counts.not_provided: Virtual capture backend or enforcement of hidden IDs in all getUserMedia selectors.

real_audio_controls.sample_rate_scope: Only the default realtime AudioContext rate when its constructor omits sampleRate. Uses native rendering/resampling and AudioWorklet rate; explicit AudioContext, OfflineAudioContext and AudioBuffer options retain precedence.
real_audio_controls.channel_scope: Cap the real destination capacity and validate actual channel changes. Default channels create the corresponding output bus; never expand physical capacity.
real_audio_controls.unsupported_default_channels: An explicitly configured initial count beyond the real/capped destination capacity raises NotSupportedError on context creation.
real_audio_controls.absent: Keep native defaults and the separately selected Native/ShardX readback mode.
real_audio_controls.not_provided: Physical device replacement, arbitrary DSP emulation, capture-track settings rewriting.

font_allowlists.format: UTF-8 comma-separated actual family names, ASCII case-insensitive, whitespace trimmed; no escaped commas.
font_allowlists.general_scope: Resolved native CSS families, local() and Local Font Access; intersects the selected font strategy.
font_allowlists.local_scope: Additional restriction for local() and Local Font Access, without changing ordinary CSS family access.
font_allowlists.absent: No additional restriction; preserve the prior branch.
font_allowlists.explicit_empty: Deny local families within that list's scope, with safe empty-glyph last resort.
font_allowlists.intentional_difference: Does not reproduce original nonexistent-name aliases or assert that missing font files exist. Downloaded web fonts remain separate.

webgl_masked_identity.requires: Both values plus a complete custom WebGL identity; maximum 512 UTF-8 bytes each.
webgl_masked_identity.scope: GL_VENDOR/GL_RENDERER display values for eligible actual hardware contexts, independent of unmasked strings.
webgl_masked_identity.software_fallback: Keep native standard WebKit/WebKit WebGL values when actual identity override is ineligible.

unimplemented_original_surfaces: Unrecovered font coverage/alias rules and actual platform font assets.
General Cloak DSP emulation, unconfirmed double-destination state, arbitrary graph/reference matching.
Gyroscope/orientation/refresh scheduling mechanisms without established source/runtime evidence.
Virtual capture backends, synthetic device identities and a complete cross-platform codec/DRM policy.
Unhandled WebGL enums/formats, HALF_FLOAT, packed/integer pixels and complete HDR equivalence; supported ShardX V2 readback/export paths are described in graphics.webgl.

surface_differences.change: Hash/filter the canonical resolved native family rather than caller spelling; src:local and CSS case variants cannot bypass the same family. Local Font Access uses the same family filter. Preserve mandatory last-resort fallback.
surface_differences.original_preserved: Original FNV/protected-name math retained and verified independently; no change to legacy/Chromix paths.

surface_differences.change: Analyser transforms only the native written prefix, preserving caller suffix. AudioBuffer copyFrom first performs the native overlap-safe copy then transforms only the copied destination prefix, avoiding source-alias writes into caller tails. copyTo only transforms its native destination write range; getChannelData retains the measured shared-PCM fixed-point rule.
surface_differences.original_preserved: Float mantissa and byte LSB formulas/salts unchanged; graph isolation remains the separate old Chromix path.

surface_differences.change: Exact font/text key plus matching host/persona, requested/resolved family, every shaped glyph's family, native width and actual glyph bounding metrics required before reference font/baseline correction.
surface_differences.limits: Generic/substituted/mixed fallback faces and mismatched geometry retain the shaped native result. Font file identity/version is not established by the vendor tables; this is a bounded coherence guard, not proof of identical source fonts.

surface_differences.change: Only Accelerometer/LinearAccelerationSensor/GravitySensor; shared parser defaults new Auto amount to0.1m/s². Explicit0 remains no bias; legacy defaults unchanged.
surface_differences.limits: No sensor fabrication, gyro/orientation/event rewriting, or Android hardware claim.

surface_differences.change: Three independent0..32 caps on browser-filtered enumeration entries; missing cap means unlimited. Preserve native IDs, labels, permission filtering, aliases and capability indices. Never add fake devices.
surface_differences.limits: Enumeration entries include native default/communications aliases. This does not disable capture by an already known native ID or alter actual capture backends/devicechange.

surface_differences.change: Reference pool/locale supplies candidate order. Select only existing native entries by exact name and ASCII-case-insensitive language; move original VoicePtr entries, preserving URI, localService and default fields. SAPI=false removes actual local entries, including entries that the reference table labels remote.
surface_differences.limits: The intersection can be empty. No missing Mac/Google/SAPI engine or voice is fabricated; actual synthesis remains native and is not exercised by these metadata tests.

surface_activation_scope.text_cloak: false preserves references; raw bypasses; strict glyph guard additionally applies.
surface_activation_scope.offset_cloak: Explicit mode is the v1 opt-in; false/raw bypass; fixed >50 and hash%81-30 algorithm; no amplitude scaling.

voice_scope: Native inventory intersection and ordering only; preserves original URI/local/default fields and native synthesis/backend. Full reference-list assembly remains a research/golden input, not the production returned inventory.

unsupported_modes.rects/cloak: No confirmed independent Cloak DOMRect numeric mechanism.
unsupported_modes.media/cloak: Original empty-list fake input has no capture backend; deliberately omitted rather than add a no-op mode.
unsupported_modes.voices/shardx: No separately established strategy in the audited target.

data_policy: Active resources contain numeric/string metadata for current text, voice, GPU and ShardX behavior; retired Cloak font pools and complete-PCM audio replacement data are removed.

windows_native_voice_compatibility.catalog: Chromium 155 network speech names and languages
windows_native_voice_compatibility.missing_language: matching primary language, otherwise original platform default
windows_native_voice_compatibility.scope: Windows native backend inventory and routing; Google names and remote attributes are compatibility declarations. Existing renderer voice filters remain effective.

headless_display_synchronization.when: Browser process, headless, complete explicit normalized screen width/height/DPR after Native/global-off removal
headless_display_synchronization.geometry: CSS dimensions to native physical screen-info pixels, outward integer rounding, declared available area retained
